title: Upcycled Ceramic Cup Herb Garden
summary: Transform an unused thrifted mug or pottery bowl into a thriving indoor kitchen herb planter.

steps.text: Wash and dry the ceramic cup thoroughly.
Add a 2cm layer of small pebbles at the bottom for vital drainage.
Fill the cup two-thirds full with fresh organic potting compost.
Carefully nestle the seedling root ball into the center.
Top with remaining soil, press gently and moisten with a spray mist.
Write the herb name and care instructions on a craft paper tag.

title: Hand-Poured Coffee Bean Soy Candle
summary: Infuse warm soy wax with aromatic roasted coffee beans in a reusable glass container.

materials.name: Lead-free cotton wick with metal tab

steps.text: Secure the wick metal tab to the center bottom of the glass jar.
Melt soy wax flakes slowly in a heatproof bowl set over simmering water.
Once liquid, stir in a spoonful of fragrant roasted coffee beans.
Pour warm wax into the jar, supporting the wick between wooden skewers.
Allow the candle to solidify at room temperature for at least 4 hours.
Trim the wick to 5mm before wrapping.

safety: Adult supervision required when handling simmering water and melted hot wax.

title: Pressed Fern & Botanical Glass Bookmark
summary: Preserve delicate pressed forest ferns between transparent laminate film trimmed with silk ribbon.

materials.name: Pressed dried fern frond or wildflower

steps.text: Arrange the dried botanicals flat against the paper strip.
Smooth clear laminate film across both sides, squeezing out air bubbles.
Neatly trim the laminate borders with scissors leaving a 3mm sealed edge.
Punch a neat hole in the center top using a hole punch.
Thread the silk ribbon through and tie a classic lark's head knot.

title: Handmade Lavender & Sea Salt Bath Soak
summary: Blend mineral-rich Epsom salt with organic dried lavender blossoms and soothing jojoba oil.

steps.text: Combine Epsom salts and coarse sea salt in a clean mixing bowl.
Drizzle jojoba oil across the salts and stir thoroughly with a wooden spoon.
Fold in dried lavender buds until evenly scattered throughout.
Spoon the bath salt mixture into the airtight glass jar.
Seal with the cork and label with recommended scoop instructions.

title: Beeswax & Pine Resin Reusable Food Wraps
summary: Coat 100% cotton fabric squares with melted pure beeswax and natural jojoba oil for plastic-free kitchen wraps.

steps.text: Pink fabric edges with zig-zag scissors to prevent fraying.
Sandwich the fabric between two sheets of baking parchment on an ironing board.
Evenly scatter grated beeswax and drizzle drops of jojoba oil across the cloth.
Pass a warm iron over the parchment until wax melts smoothly into the fibers.
Lift the parchment while warm and wave the fabric for 30 seconds to set.

safety: Exercise care with the hot clothing iron to avoid burns on fingertips.

title: Whittled Cedar Wood Jam Spreader
summary: Carve a functional breakfast butter and jam knife from a fallen cedar or cherry branch.

materials.name: Food-grade mineral oil or walnut oil

steps.text: Draw the spreader blade and handle silhouette directly on the branch bark.
Carefully whittle away excess wood with push-cuts away from your body.
Shape the tapered blade edge to approximately 2mm thickness.
Sand progressing through 120, 240 and 400 grit until silky smooth.
Wipe with food-safe walnut oil to reveal deep wood grain.

safety: Use a sharp whittling knife with cut-resistant thumb guard; always carve away from hands.

title: Hand-Stitched Japanese Bookbinding Notebook
summary: Bind single sheets of linen paper using traditional Yotsume Toji four-hole thread stitching.

steps.text: Stack and align the paper sheets neatly between cardstock covers.
Mark four evenly spaced hole locations 1cm from the spine edge.
Pierce clean holes through the entire stack using the sharp awl.
Thread the needle and weave through the holes in the traditional four-hole pattern.
Tie off the knot securely at the head corner and trim thread ends.

safety: Take care when piercing dense cardstock with the pointed bookbinding awl.

title: Cold-Infused Rosemary & Chili Olive Oil
summary: Steep sprigs of garden rosemary and whole dried bird's eye chilies in premium extra virgin olive oil.

materials.name: Sterilized glass bottle with swing stopper

steps.text: Ensure the fresh rosemary is completely dry to prevent moisture spoilage.
Gently bruise the rosemary leaves with the back of a knife to release aromatics.
Insert rosemary stems and whole chilies into the clean glass bottle.
Pour extra virgin olive oil over the aromatics until fully submerged.
Seal tightly and store in a cool pantry for 7 days before gifting.

title: Clay Essential Oil Aromatherapy Pebble
summary: Mold natural terracotta air-dry clay into organic textured palm stones that hold essential oil drops.

materials.name: Air-dry terracotta or white modeling clay
Fresh botanical leaves for pressing texture

steps.text: Roll the modeling clay into smooth round pebble shapes in your palms.
Press fresh botanical leaves firmly into the clay surface to leave an imprint.
Shape a shallow hollow in the center to catch future oil drops.
Let dry undisturbed on a wire rack for 48 hours until hardened.
Package in a small muslin pouch alongside the essential oil vial.

title: Hanging Macrame Plant Holder in Natural Jute
summary: Knot unbleached jute rope into an airy hanging cradle for potted succulents or trailing ivy.

materials.name: 3mm twisted natural jute or cotton cord

steps.text: Cut eight lengths of cord, each 3 meters long, and loop them through the wooden ring.
Secure the top with a neat gathering knot 5cm below the ring.
Separate cords into 4 pairs and tie square knots down each strand.
Thread wooden beads onto the strands and tie locking half-hitches.
Connect adjacent strands 10cm lower to form the basket net for the pot.
Finish with a sturdy base gathering knot and trim the tassel evenly.

title: Cinnamon & Orange Stovetop Simmer Pot Kit
summary: Dried citrus wheels, cinnamon quills and whole cloves in a mason jar for aromatic home boiling.

steps.text: Layer dried oranges and cinnamon sticks in jar.
Add star anise and whole cloves.
Tie twine and recipe instructions to simmer in water.

title: Recycled Cardboard Desktop Sloth Phone Stand
summary: Precision cut layered corrugated cardboard creating an ergonomic angled mobile phone cradle.

steps.text: Draw the sloth silhouette with an angled front groove.
Carefully cut 4 identical profile slices using craft cutter.
Glue the layers together under a heavy book.
Sand edges smooth when completely dry.

safety: Adult supervision required when using sharp craft cutter.

title: Custom Loose Leaf Tea Blending Box
summary: Curate a personalized herbal tea blend combining organic dried peppermint, chamomile and rosehips.

steps.text: Mix dried botanicals gently in a sterile stainless bowl.
Funnel the blend into an airtight metal caddy.
Write custom brewing instructions (5 min steep at 95°C).

title: Hand-Rolled Honeycomb Beeswax Tapers
summary: Roll pure honeycomb wax sheets tightly around natural cotton wicks without heating.

steps.text: Lay wax sheet flat at room temperature.
Press cotton wick firmly along the leading edge.
Roll tightly and evenly keeping edges aligned.
Gently press the seam flat with fingertips.

title: Terrarium Moss & River Stone Forest Globe
summary: Assemble living cushion moss, charcoal and river pebbles in a sealed decorative glass globe.

steps.text: Place drainage pebbles at bottom of glass jar.
Sprinkle charcoal layer to keep moisture fresh.
Arrange clean live moss and river pebbles neatly.
Lightly mist with distilled water and seal lid.

title: Botanical Cyanotype Sun-Printed Greeting Cards
summary: Expose sun-sensitive paper under pressed foliage outdoors for deep Prussian blue note cards.

steps.text: Place leaves onto cyanotype paper in shade.
Weigh down with glass sheet and expose to sunlight for 3 minutes.
Rinse card in cool running water for 2 minutes.
Dry flat between paper towels to reveal white and blue contrast.

title: Hand-Sewn Linen Coffee Filter Cone
summary: Sew washable unbleached linen fabric into a reusable eco-friendly pour-over coffee cone filter.

steps.text: Fold linen in half and mark the standard cone shape.
Stitch the angled side seam with durable double backstitch.
Trim seam allowance and turn inside out.
Boil in plain water for 10 minutes to pre-shrink and sterilize.

title: Personalized Wood-Burned Cooking Spatula
summary: Pyrography etch botanical leaves or recipient initials onto a smooth beechwood spoon handle.

steps.text: Lightly sketch design onto wood with pencil.
Plug in burning tool and allow tip to heat up fully.
Trace pencil lines with steady, slow pressure.
Allow tool to cool completely on heat-safe stand.

safety: Hot woodburning iron tip reaches high temperatures; adult caution required.

title: Dried Orange & Star Anise Kitchen Garland
summary: Thread dehydrating citrus rounds and fragrant star anise pods onto rustic natural twine.

steps.text: Thread jute string onto tapestry needle.
Alternate piercing through orange centers and tied anise pods.
Tie hanging loops at both ends of the garland.

title: Aromatic Cedar Shaving Drawer Sachets
summary: Fill breathable cotton muslin pouches with aromatic fresh cedar shavings and dried rosemary.
